messages:
aisha: Hey team — quick eyes pls. PR #8338 is queued for the merge window in ~2h. Canary runs show a small but consistent p95 bump on small-batch workloads. Leaving artifacts and a short summary below. Want to know if this is acceptable for a merge or if we hold.
ben: Can you paste the bench command & artifact link? quick check only.
aisha: Sure — bench command and results (trimmed):
```
./bench/run.sh --suite=small-batch --samples=200 --seed=42
Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4567/artifacts/bench-3187654321.tar.gz
Key numbers (control -> candidate): p50 12.1ms -> 12.3ms, p95 86.0ms -> 93.1ms (+8.2%), throughput -1.5%, mem p95 +120MB
```
Full bench log is in the artifact. I also uploaded flame graphs to the same job.
mei: Did the canary have the same instance count/tiling as prod? sometimes lower concurrency skews p95.
aisha: Canary cfg: 10% traffic, 8 replicas, same batch horizon config as prod. No tiling changes in this PR, but there is an allocator tweak that slightly changes prefill behavior.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for refs/pull/8338/head — 10% traffic, region=us-west-2. Status: 10/10 replicas healthy.
tom: Curious if this shows up in longseq or only small-batch. Any longseq numbers?
aisha: Longseq quick smoke: p95 stable (within noise). The regression is isolated to small-batch microbench (workload with N<=8 tokens and high QPS). Attached: flame graph link https://ci.redwood/jobs/4567/artifacts/flame-3187654321.html
ben: That mem delta (+120MB) is concerning. Is it persistent or transient during ramp? Can you post heap snapshots?
aisha: Heap snapshot uploaded: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4567/artifacts/heap-3187654321.tar.gz — looks like KV cache shard allocation is slightly higher on this branch (allocation path changed). I'm looking into whether the allocator tweak increases shard pre-alloc.
mei: If it's a KV prealloc variance, we might be able to tweak config on canary to compensate and re-run. Can we do a quick A/B: same branch but revert allocator tweak at runtime (config flip)?
aisha: I can run that. Re-ran with kv_cache_prefill=false: p95 returned to 86.5ms, mem p95 back to baseline. So it seems correlated.
tom: OK that's a good repro. My vote: hold the merge until we either narrow the allocator delta or make the prefill opt-in for now. We should also add a microbench regression test.
ben: I can +1 the hold. I'd prefer another run with different seeds to be safe but given canary shows consistent regression, hold for now.
mei: I'll put a canary hold and tag this thread in the merge calendar. Need 2 approvals to hold? usually we just mark hold and ops blocks merge.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by ops at 3187655200 — reason: perf regression flagged by eng-runtime.
aisha: Thanks. I'll open a follow-up PR to make prefill opt-in and add a microbench. Will ping when I have a narrow fix. Appreciate the quick checks. :thanks:
ben: Thanks — lgtm for holding. Ping me when you want a re-run.
tom: I'll take a look at allocator codepath tonight and post notes tomorrow morning.
mei: tagging @eng-sre for visibility.

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: from ben, :eyes: from tom)
